questions.stem: A grouped table shows: $0 \leq x < 10$ (freq $5$), $10 \leq x < 20$ (freq $8$), $20 \leq x < 30$ (freq $7$). What is the estimated mean?
When estimating the mean from grouped data, you use the midpoint of each class because:

options.text: The midpoint is always the mode
The exact values are unknown, so the midpoint is the best estimate
The midpoint is always the median

questions.explanation: Since individual data values are not known in grouped data, the midpoint of each class is used as a representative value. This gives an estimate rather than an exact mean.
